subject: Temporary subprocessor delegation & termination instructions
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@bigbank.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary analytics vendor (EdgePrism) — delegation & termination controls

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. As mentioned, BigBank is moving a small pilot that will route telemetry to a temporary analytics partner (EdgePrism) for a 6-week study. Before we sign anything I need the following from Redwood: a clear list of subprocessors involved for this pilot, your proposed DPA addendum language for temporary processors, and explicit termination / data-return & deletion steps we can include in our procurement paperwork.

Can you confirm:
- Whether EdgePrism will process any customer-identifying metadata or just aggregated telemetry?
- The timeline for onboarding + how we can force an immediate termination (technical cut + certificate revocation) if needed.

We’re on a tight schedule — procurement wants confirmation by COB Monday. If there’s a standard temp-subprocessor playbook or checklist you can share that would speed things up.

Appreciate it,
Sarah Chen
Director, Vendor Risk — BigBank Corp.
Attachments: none

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Temporary analytics vendor (EdgePrism) — delegation & termination controls

Internal —

Looping you both in. BigBank wants a fast turn here. Quick plan:
1) Legal to review and provision a one-page DPA addendum for temporary subprocessors (I attached a draft).
2) Security to pull the EdgePrism security pack and confirm scope (we have last year’s pack but procurement will want current evidence).
3) Ops to prepare immediate-cut runbook: API key revocation, routing rule removal, and S3 retention snapshot.

Action items:
- Kimberly: can you cover security evidence and give a short yes/no on whether EdgePrism processes pii metadata?
- Marissa: procurement / sales cadence — confirm whether we can accept a 6-week pilot with the termination clause we typically use (30-day data purge upon termination + 72-hour revocation window). If not, propose edits.
- Priyom: please prepare the DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum once Legal signs off.

Attaching: temp_subproc_checklist.pdf (checklist), dpa_addendum_draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll coordinate external responses.

- Aditya
Product Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@bigbank.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary analytics vendor (EdgePrism) — delegation & termination controls

Sarah —

Thanks — and hi everyone. I pulled the latest security pack from EdgePrism (see attached summary). Short answers up front:
- EdgePrism collects aggregated telemetry only; they have a flag that can strip session IDs before ingestion. We will require that flag enabled for the pilot and will treat any accidental PID/PII as a termination criterion.
- Termination: operations will perform API key rotation and a routing rule update, which severs live ingestion immediately. Within 72 hours we will provide a data-export snapshot if BigBank requires and start the 30-day deletion process from our staging buckets. If BigBank requires immediate deletion confirmation we can escalate to a 7-day accelerated purge with certificates of destruction for the exported snapshot.

Next steps I propose we follow:
- Legal signs the DPA addendum (I reviewed Aditya’s draft and made three small redline suggestions).
- Procurement (Marissa / Priyom) sends the DocuSign envelope. I’ll attach the EdgePrism security summary and a short runbook.

Links: DocuSign (pending legal): https://www.docusign.com/containers/DocuSignLinkExample/CC-2391
Quick evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink
Jira (internal tracking): JIRA-4578

Attachments referenced: edgeprism_security_pack.zip, temp_subproc_checklist.pdf

Kimberly Park
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@bigbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, ops@edgeprism.io
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary analytics vendor (EdgePrism) — delegation & termination controls

Thanks — that addresses most of our questions. A couple quick clarifications:
- Please confirm in the DPA addendum that the "flag to strip session IDs" will be enabled by default for this engagement and that any deviation requires our written approval.
- We will accept the 30-day deletion path provided we get a certificate of deletion and an export snapshot within the 72-hour window. If Redwood initiates the accelerated 7-day purge we will require the same certificate.

EdgePrism ops (cc’d): ops@edgeprism.io — please coordinate with Kimberly on evidence and confirm the session-id stripping setting is available and currently in prod.

Sarah Chen
Director, Vendor Risk — BigBank Corp.
